summary: 16-year-old Beau Richey of Pleasant Grove, Utah, lost control of his ATV coming around a bend off County Road 315 near Silt; the nearly 400-pound ATV fell on him, causing severe chest injuries, and he was pronounced dead at St. Mary's Hospital in Grand Junction.
